description: Election Commission - Local Authority Election - 2025 Notice under Section 66(2) Elected Members List - Puttalam District
categorisation: This gazette contains election results and declarations for local authorities, specifically announcing the names of elected members for various wards and the members returned for Local Authorities under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. This fits squarely within the Elections category (Type 7) as it deals with election results and declarations.
